next_stop.format: dodge Data preparation before init failed: %d @%s:%d
dodge Data preparation before init failed: %d @%s:%d

scope: Original APFS and RamBlock write a separately identified flat-file overlay with completed VirtIO FLUSH operations. After actual SIGKILL, a fresh VM resumes the same overlay without reset, mounts Data and completes the original keybag/persona tasks. Independent read-only APFS extraction confirms the same generated persona identifiers. Wrong device identity and a valid-CRC foreign seed are refused before Data mounting, without changing either store. Both system disks remain read-only. Persona values stay local; this is VM-file persistence, not physical UFS or hardware protection.
